what: Zeta Global sells marketing software built around its own consumer data: it identifies who a company's customers are, predicts what they will buy, and runs the email, text and advertising campaigns that reach them.
customers: Large consumer brands, retailers, banks and insurers running direct marketing campaigns.
money: subscription and usage fees for the marketing platform
moat: A consumer identity dataset built over a decade combined with the software that acts on it, so customers buy data and execution together rather than assembling them.
risks: 230 times earnings: reported profit is minimal because of stock compensation
A short-seller report in 2024 questioned its data sourcing and customer quality
Marketing budgets are cut quickly in a downturn
opportunities: $260M of free cash flow on $1.7B of revenue
Revenue grew from $458M to $1.3B in four years
Analysts see about 25% upside, with 14 covering the stock
watch: Scaled customer count and revenue per scaled customer.
